Best move: **Column 5**.

That drops Red into **c5 row 4**, next to your Red at **c4 row 4** and also connecting diagonally with **c6 row 3**. It’s the move that keeps your winning chances alive by building threats instead of just reacting.

A good way to see it: ask, “After I play here, do I create multiple future ways to make four?” Column 5 does that best here.
